title: setup writes global git config before the first sync succeeds
description: Reported by sankarshan in the OpenVTC Signal group 2026-10-25; Mark replied 'will fix'. cmd_setup sets gpg.format=ssh, gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile/revocationFile and vouch.registry globally, then syncs. A failed fetch or check leaves global config pointing at files that were never written, breaking SSH signature verification in every repo. Fix: fetch, check and write both files first; set config (including --min-tier/--include-automation) only after success.
acceptance_criteria: A setup whose fetch fails leaves global git config unchanged; a failed re-setup to a bad URL keeps the previous working config; existing setup/sync tests pass.
close_reason: setup syncs before writing config and refuses to change existing OpenPGP/X.509 signing or SSH signer files; gate green 3.12/3.9
